title: TestAtlas Example Script
description: The 19th JSON Schema (Plan 08-01). Describes the deterministic replay recipe for `examples/<name>/_testatlas-fixture/example-script.json`. The replay engine in scripts/lib/regenerate-core.js validates a script against this schema BEFORE invoking any Phase 5 emitter — bad scripts never mutate disk.

suiteVersionRange.description: Optional semver range. The replay engine logs a warning if the running suite version does not satisfy this range, but does not refuse to replay (pinning is informational here).

fixedTimestamp.description: ISO-8601 timestamp injected into TESTATLAS_FIXED_TIMESTAMP for every replayed step. Must remain stable across regenerations.

id.description: Stable identifier for this step. Used for logging + diff messages.

args.description: Free-form key/value pairs flagified into `--key value` for the underlying emitter. Array values are repeated as `--key v1 --key v2`. Booleans become bare `--key` flags when true.

comment.description: Optional human comment retained in the fixture for readability.
